correctness.rationale: Every Boolean noun comparison equality cancels into one nonzero {-1,0,1}^4 coefficient row up to negation, hence exactly 40 signed directions. Rank-three equations give a one-dimensional primitive positive rational kernel. Each 3x3 cofactor has absolute determinant at most 5 by Hadamard; thus every primitive coordinate is <=5. An exhaustive exact enumeration of 40 choose 3 = 9,880 row triples, together with a separate bounded primitive-candidate rank census (63 sorted primitive positive vectors) reproduces exactly eight classes, 75 labeled ratios and sum distribution {4:1,5:4,6:10,7:12,8:24,10:24}. All multiples of the primitive vector are exactly the realized finite atom models, giving spectrum s N_{>0}. The finite census is exhaustive only because the determinant bound and row encoding were proved first.
